behaviour: A sour liquid made by souring wine, cider, grain or fruit. It sharpens a dressing, lifts a rich stew and keeps pickles. It turns harsh if it is boiled hard, so it goes in late or is cooked down on purpose.

contains.basis: Vinegar keeps a trace of the alcohol it is made from.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with gelatine or isinglass.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with isinglass from fish.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with egg white.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with milk protein.
Made from wine, which nearly always holds sulphites.
Malt vinegar is made from barley.

safety.note: A named vinegar such as red wine or sherry vinegar has a file of its own. This one stands for any vinegar a recipe does not name, so every answer is strict.
